handshake.title: Terrace: Resume from evidence, not memory

roles.creator: The creator owns orchestration and gate semantics.
roles.system_or_ai: Terrace stores stage state, emits the stop packet, rejects unsupported bypasses, and resumes the owning stage after a bounded correction.
roles.human: The human owns corrections, exceptions, and release decisions.

claim_boundary: TR-1 is the representative historical routing regression; the bounded-resume fixture is synthetic reproducibility evidence.
The integrated commit is present on local dev. The source branch was not pushed.
The current preview was captured before integration and must not be presented as a fresh integrated capture until refreshed.
open_gates: Refresh the TR-6 visual capture after integration when a permitted browser can render the local page.
Choose and verify a public no-auth host for the refreshed page if replacing the repository link.
